assessment_source: Local Eduqas C720QS specification and retained 2019/2023/2024 Component 1 papers and mark schemes
decisions: VAGGAS includes two distinct G themes. It is a flexible memory aid; retain Kingship as a seventh theme.
The 15-mark task is close analysis of the printed extract. Whole-play selection applies to the separate 25-mark essay.
Dagger vision precedes regicide; do not say the completed murder causes the earlier vision.
Succession argument rests on Duncan explicitly naming Malcolm; do not assert a simple universal primogeniture rule for medieval Scotland.
Divine right is a historical belief. Religious language and royal patronage support interpretations, not proof of a divine appointment or a single authorial intention.
Regicide, sacrilege and blasphemy are related concepts, not interchangeable definitions.
Banquo is tempted; Lady Macbeth is influential early but does not control all subsequent crimes; Macduff combines grief, justice and national duty.
Retain concise character notes, separate theme sections, method/effect links and full-width readable A4 typography.
New quick tasks and essays are original practice, with no invented recurrence claim.
